# url 2.5.8 — 2026-09-14

- crates.io: https://crates.io/crates/url
- docs: https://docs.rs/url/2.5.8/url/
- license: MIT OR Apache-2.0

`Url::parse` for `MSN_URL`: reject userinfo, query, fragment, non-`/` path; require `https` unless host is `localhost` / `127.0.0.1` / `::1`. Cursor binding uses `Url::origin().ascii_serialization()` (JS-style origin, including non-default ports).
